''1ˢᵗ'' - Bisyeet |difficulty = Normal |length_measurement = 01:20.48 |wave_structure = Normal |rewards = {{RewardsList|Normal|Hardcore = Hide|Voidcore = Hide}} |modifiers = [[Space Suit]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Moon Base''' is a [[Maps|map]] that takes place on the moon, as suggested by the name. It has been remade once since its addition to the game. '''Moon Base''' has the [[Space Suit]] modifier, which adds astronaut helmets onto every enemy. ==Design & Path== {{Tabber |Current |The current version of '''Moon Base''' takes place on the surface of the moon, as indicated by the grey rocks, American flags (a Thailand flag can also be seen), the Earth in the background and the lunar launch pad. The entire complex appears to be within the rocks connected by tube walkways. Satellites and moon buildings are seen dominating the landscape. A deep spike pit can also be seen on this map. It is a large and expansive map. The grey path starts at the rocket launch pad. It goes under the rock overhang and meanders around the moon cliffs and artificial objects. The path then ends outside the entrance of the moon base. |Version 1 |The first version of '''Moon Base''' took place on the surface of the moon, with the grey rocks, American flags and lunar launch pad indictive of this. High cliffs flank the entire map and a deep spike pit could be seen near the beginning of the map. The entire complex appeared to be within the rocks connected by tube walkways. Satellites and moon buildings were seen dominating the landscape. A crashed UFO can be seen in the middle of the map. The grey path started at the rocket launch pad. It went under the rock overhang and meandered around the moon cliffs and artificial objects. The path then ended outside the entrance of the moon base encased in the cliff. }} ==Interactive Map== {{Map:Moon Base}} ==Rewards== The game calculates how many {{Coins|Coins}}, {{Gem|Gems}} and {{Exp|}} you receive based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 50% more {{Exp|}} (Friday – Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned is multiplied by 1.5x through the [[XP Boost]] modifier. The VIP [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] also multiplies any {{Exp|}} earned by 1.25x through the [[VIP Boost]] modifier. These two boosts are additive. Regular {{Exp|}} boosts are multiplicative with other modifiers present on this map. Any rewards that end in a decimal point is rounded down, no matter the first figure of the leading decimal. {{Rewards|Normal|Hardcore = Hide|Voidcore = Hide}} ==Strategy== *The map is quite long, though it is likely that most of your towers will be concentrated near the middle of the map as this is where most of the path's turns are. **Be warned that space is limited in this spot. Sell towers that are not as important as others. *As this map is quite large, the [[DJ Booth]] can be quite helpful in maximizing range. *Since the spawn is a distance away from where most of your towers should be, expect summoning enemies, such as the [[Necromancer (Modern Enemy)|Necromancer]] and [[Fallen Necromancer]], to spawn in a few enemies before you can attack them. *As the map is quite long, it may take a while for [[units]] from towers like the [[Military Base]] or [[Crook Boss]] to reach the start of the map. *With the exception of the cliff near the exit, all the other cliff spots on this map are glitched, so you cannot place cliff towers on them. As such, the space available for cliff towers is very limited on this map. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} MoonBase.png|First version (19 July 2019 – 29 October 2020) {{GalleryHeader|View}} Moon.png|First version (19 July 2019 – 29 October 2020) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} 7c79e91c6f02f70ece662a2764aab1d1.jpg|First version on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Development Images}} OldMoonBaseDI1.png|First version on a development image. MoonBaseDI.jpg|Unreleased version on a development image. }} ==Trivia== *Unlike many other maps that existed prior to the [[Release v1.0|MEGA Update]], this map was not remade or removed in the [[Release v1.0|MEGA Update]]. **This was quite strange considering that the map had a blocky style, similar to maps that were remade. **This map was later remade in the [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]]. *Several Robloxians could be seen around the map in the first version of '''Moon Base'''. **These Robloxians were changed to [https://www.roblox.com/users/53017915/profile SweetHiddenlove] and Bisyeet in the second version of the map. *As the sun is on the side of the Earth furthest away from the moon, it would not be theoretically possible to see the Earth. ==Update History== *'''19 July 2019''' - [[BETA v1.6|BETA v1.6.0]] **'''Moon Base''' added. *'''5 August 2019''' - [[BETA v1.8|BETA v1.8.0]] **{{Color|OldNormal}} difficulty removed. *'''29 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul v1.0.0]] **'''Moon Base''' remade. **{{Color|Normal}} difficulty added. **No longer gives a badge upon first triumph. **{{Bug}} Most cliff spots are ground spots. *'''4 July 2022''' - [[v1.2.5]] **[[Space Suit]] modifier added. {{MapNavBox}}
